name: decide-build-ship
description: A complete, decision-first product workflow for Claude Code: discover the product with expert research and a guided interview, settle decisions and review the owner's answers, plan thin slices, design the interface, build test-first with parallel agents, verify with a changed-only gate and a live check, ship only when green and approved, run the loop autonomously per milestone, report progress on request, and hand off safely across sessions.
